scientific_integrity: Finite exhaustive tests support but do not establish the infinite-family theorem. Explicit cyclic-residue-ring special cases and general Clifford theory are prior art; independent auditing was not performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes finite commutative chain rings, not arbitrary local rings; equality of class/degree multisets does not imply group or character-table isomorphism. Possible equivalent formulations in specialist literature remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Conjugacy and ordinary character spectra of affine groups over finite chain rings
